text:
amy_sales: Quick presales note for GreenMed POC (2 weeks). Customer asks: EU-only tenant, BYOK mandatory, keys must be region-locked to eu-west-1 (Ireland). Primary: ireland, failover: frankfurt (compute-only). Need subprocessors CSV, a one-line KMS statement for their questionnaire, confirmation whether Hosted can meet BYOK+region-lock with an SLA, and a rough monthly cost delta for pinning. cc @mike_platform @sara_sec

 mike_platform: Dedicated or Private are the recommended paths. Hosted can do region affinity but cannot guarantee key-region-lock or provide per-tenant latency SLAs because it's a shared pool. Hosted-BYOK is possible under a legal addendum but still not region-lockable to the same degree as Dedicated/Private. For strict key residency and p95 SLAs you need Dedicated (tenant_pin) or Private VPC.

 sara_sec: Subprocessors short list you can give procurement: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP (europe-west3), Cloudflare, Fastly, Datadog, Sentry, Splunk (logging), HashiCorp Vault (KMS partner). I'll upload the signed CSV + attestation pack to the presales folder.

 amy_sales: Please also give a one-line KMS sentence and an SLA sentence I can paste into the questionnaire.

 sara_sec: KMS one-liner: "Customer-managed, HSM-backed BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; Hosted-BYOK may be provided under a legal addendum with extra attestation."

 sara_sec: SLA sentence: "Dedicated tenants can be offered per-route/per-model latency SLOs (p95 targets) after capacity reservation and sizing; Hosted endpoints run on shared pools and cannot receive per-tenant latency SLAs."

 mike_platform: Cost delta (rough ballpark example): Customer estimated peak 15 rps, avg seq 110 tokens -> ~1650 tokens/sec (99k tokens/min). With caching/batching assume 1.5x efficiency. For a 50-60ms p95 target we'd reserve capacity: typical uplift = monthly reservation fee (~$4k-$7k/mo) + per-token price uplift (~12-25%) depending on chosen model and GPU mix. Cross-region failover may incur egress charges per contract. This is a back-of-envelope; we'll need final rps + model selection to quote.

 amy_sales: Can you paste a tiny routing policy snippet and a mini latency test script to hand to their infra team?

 mike_platform: Routing policy example (minimal JSON):

 ```json
 {
   "tenant": "greenmed-poc",
   "routing": {
     "mode": "tenant_pin",
     "primary_region": "eu-west-1",
     "failover_order": ["eu-central-1"],
     "failover_behavior": "blocked_if_key_unavailable"
   },
   "kms": {
     "mode": "byok_hsm",
     "region_lock": "eu-west-1",
     "replication": "customer_option"
   }
 }
 ```

 mike_platform: Tiny p95 test (bash) to run from their Ireland office: 

 ```bash
 for i in {1..200}; do
   t0=$(date +%s%3N)
   curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' >/dev/null
   t1=$(date +%s%3N)
   echo $((t1-t0))
 done | sort -n | awk 'NR==int(0.95*NR){print "p95:"$1}'
 ```

 ops_bot: Ops notes: Dedicated tenant provisioning typically 5-8 business days after PO and capacity allocation. BYOK HSM import and attestation add ~3-7 business days. Need from customer: CIDR for VPC peering (if applicable), confirmation of failover behavior (blocked vs replicated), and whether they will replicate keys to eu-central-1 or accept a contractual exception.

 amy_sales: I'll collect CIDR and their choice on key replication and update the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
